source_caption_text:
Uzi really heard the word “shells” fifty times and decided to drop a top-tier verse 😂🔥

Lil Uzi Vert really slid on “Shells” like his rent was due. The second his verse comes in, the whole energy of the song changes. Shabazz PBG sets up the track, then Uzi jumps in with that rapid-fire flow and barely gives the beat a chance to breathe.

What makes the verse stand out is how effortlessly Uzi rides the production. He switches his cadence, speeds through the lines, and keeps the same intensity from beginning to end without sounding out of control. It’s one of those verses where you can hear the confidence in every bar, and the delivery makes the beat feel like it was built for him.

“Shells” is also one of those songs where the wait for the feature is part of the experience. You sit through the intro knowing Uzi is about to come in, and then everything suddenly kicks into another gear. That verse has become one of those late-2010s Uzi moments fans still bring up whenever the conversation turns to his hardest features.

#liluzivert #rap #hiphop
